title: Privacy Policy
meta_description: Privacy Policy for Barbuk (barbuk.us). How we collect, use, and protect your personal data. GDPR-compliant contact form handling.

page_hero.title: Privacy Policy
page_hero.intro: Last updated: 13 October 2026. This policy describes how Barbuk ('we', 'us', or 'our') collects, uses, and protects your personal data when you visit barbuk.us or use our services.

sections.heading: 1. Data Controller
sections.body: The data controller for barbuk.us is Barbuk. Contact: hello@barbuk.us.

sections.heading: 2. What Data We Collect
sections.body: We collect data you provide voluntarily: name, email, company, and message via the contact form. We do not use third-party analytics that track individual users (no Google Analytics, no Facebook Pixel).

sections.heading: 3. Purpose of Processing
sections.body: Contact form submissions are processed solely to respond to your inquiry. We do not use your data for marketing, retargeting, or automated decision-making.

sections.heading: 4. Legal Basis (GDPR)
sections.body: Processing is based on Article 6(1)(a) GDPR (consent) for contact form submissions and Article 6(1)(f) GDPR (legitimate interest) for site operation and security.

sections.heading: 5. Data Storage and Retention
sections.body: Contact form submissions are stored in a private Google Sheet accessible only to the data controller. We retain submissions for 12 months unless a business relationship is established, in which case standard accounting retention rules apply.

sections.heading: 6. Your Rights
sections.body: Under GDPR you have the right to access, rectify, erase, restrict processing, data portability, and object to processing. Contact hello@barbuk.us to exercise these rights. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority.

sections.heading: 7. Cookies
sections.body: barbuk.us does not use tracking cookies. We use only Cloudflare's essential cookies required for DDoS protection and bot detection.

sections.heading: 8. Third-Party Services
sections.body: We use Cloudflare Pages and Cloudflare Workers for hosting and contact form processing. We use Google Apps Script as a backend to append contact submissions to a private Google Sheet. These services have their own privacy policies.

sections.heading: 9. International Transfers
sections.body: Cloudflare and Google may process data outside the EEA. Both providers offer Standard Contractual Clauses or equivalent safeguards under GDPR.

sections.heading: 10. Security
sections.body: Contact form submissions are transmitted over HTTPS. Our Cloudflare Worker uses CORS validation and a honeypot field to prevent automated abuse. We do not store payment data.

sections.heading: 11. Changes to This Policy
sections.body: We may update this policy. The 'Last updated' date at the top reflects the most recent revision. Material changes will be highlighted on the homepage.

sections.heading: 12. Contact
sections.body: For privacy questions or to exercise your rights, email hello@barbuk.us.
